summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by avoiding coercion of objects with a `values` property, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch introduces a conditional check for `pd.Series`, `pd.Index`, and `pd.DataFrame`, which might inadvertently affect other types or libraries that also have a `values` attribute.
The code could benefit from additional comments explaining why specific types are being checked, improving readability.
